parent_lamp_requirement_errors_preserved.message: Unresolved: Architecture A selected by owner: isolated CC driver in base, simple LED panel. Select/verify its LED and driver implementation using power, tolerance, thermal and cost calculations; no fixed LED count or current.

Unresolved: Implement the product-level safety/operating criteria from U16: determine numerical circuit limits, discharge/cooling implementation, short duration/recovery, hot/cold startup and disturbance response.
Unresolved: Develop thermal/life calculations and detailed optical measurement procedures using the specification decisions from U14/U15; define base lifetime/end-of-life basis.

Unresolved: Select overtemperature behavior, thresholds and protection-fault response (including sensor faults only if a sensor is selected); define absence/reversal/partial-contact abuse cases even though live replacement is forbidden.
Unresolved: Freeze panel/base pin map and independently reviewed intended connectivity with exact datasheet/pin/footprint basis.
Unresolved: Freeze preliminary enclosure envelope, heat path/contact, insulation materials, dimensions, heights, keying and retention.
Unresolved: Confirm actual stackup, copper, materials and service limits as needed for insulation/layout/assembly.
Unresolved: Confirm available calibrated instruments, personnel, samples, test limits and stop conditions. Release evidence must cover actual operating/fault conditions.
Unresolved: Establish BOM availability, exact costs, release outputs, matched revisions and test/programming/assembly instructions.

Unresolved: Final handover deadline 30 September 2027 accepted; the proposed staged planning baseline is recorded. Confirm actual laboratory/iteration bookings before affected work/tests, without blocking ordinary design on bookings.

scope: Parent31failures are not closed by changing scope. This explicit bare-board contract documents only actual preprocurement work; parentassembledlamp/physicalrelease remains separate and open.
